## Design

### 2026-09-30 — I worked on some of the initial ideas and decided what would be reasonable to do in my time frame.

**0.5h**

I worked on some of the initial ideas and decided what would be reasonable to do in my time frame.
First i talked about what it actually was, than i listed out my goals for the project, what objects it could count, some of the items i would need, expected problems and stuff i would include in V1 vs V2 if i make a V2.

### 2026-10-01 — I changes the bracket for mounting the pieces together, i changed it from cylindrical mount shape to a squarish one to allow for the screws to have more space, i also changed the angle a bit on the in

**0.5h**

I changes the bracket for mounting the pieces together, i changed it from cylindrical mount shape to a squarish one to allow for the screws to have more space, i also changed the angle a bit on the inside of the zig zagy one so that it would slow the parts down even more to allow the ir sensor to work better
